fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: Throws a point that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that. Holds up to 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Both Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Looses 2 points that fly apart, each dealing 11 damage and stunning what it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Prong After Prong
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Both Points Tried
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
